BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The archive is supplied by a remote user, for example as an upload.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Entry names containing ../ are enough; no special conditions are needed.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The upload or extraction endpoint is reachable without authentication.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: Extraction happens without any victim action.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Files are written with the same process permissions.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Overwritten files can lead to limited data exposure.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Arbitrary files outside the target folder can be overwritten, including code or configuration.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Overwriting files can cause limited disruption.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
